## Checklist

- [ ] No Sungrow files, firmware images, packages, keys, serial numbers or addresses inside stock firmware are added (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Protocol and hardware facts cite [SG-Docs](https://github.com/NickStallman/SG-Docs) or a public document
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated with `make gen` (never edited by hand)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`
